title: La-Ribo: RNA Co-Design via Geometry-Latent Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.12236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: RNA function arises from the coupling of nucleotide sequence and three-dimensional structure, motivating their joint design. Coordinating global folding with nucleotide-level detail remains challenging under limited structural supervision. We introduce La-Ribo, a generative framework for RNA sequence-structure co-design via geometry-latent flow matching. La-Ribo retains a sparse phosphate-sugar--base scaffold and encodes nucleotide identity and local conformation in residue-wise latents. A shared flow network generates both jointly, and an RNA-specific decoder then reconstructs all heavy atoms. To expand supervision, we construct a quality-controlled corpus of 168,561 RNA structures, integrating experimental data with predictions from three folding models, including 10,631 MSA-supported structures generated in this work. translated_title: La-Ribo：基于几何-潜在流匹配的RNA协同设计
translated_abstract: RNA的功能源于核苷酸序列与三维结构的耦合，这促使对二者进行联合设计。在结构监督数据有限的情况下，协调全局折叠与核苷酸层面的细节仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了La-Ribo，一个通过几何-潜在流匹配实现RNA序列-结构协同设计的生成式框架。La-Ribo保留了稀疏的磷酸-糖-碱基骨架，并将核苷酸身份与局部构象编码为残基级潜在变量。一个共享的流网络对二者进行联合生成，随后由一个RNA专用解码器重建所有重原子。为扩展监督数据，我们构建了一个经过质量控制的语料库，包含168,561个RNA结构，将实验数据与三种折叠模型的预测相结合，其中包括本工作生成的10,631个由MSA支持的结构。在跨越多种采样预算和两种评估设置的情况下，La-Ribo相较所评估的基线方法提升了可设计性与协同设计性。
tldr: La-Ribo提出了一种基于几何-潜在流匹配的生成框架，利用共享流网络联合生成RNA序列与三维结构，并通过包含168,561个结构的质量控制语料库扩展监督，在可设计性和协同设计性上超越了现有基线方法。
en_tdlr: La-Ribo introduces a generative framework for RNA sequence-structure co-design via geometry-latent flow matching with a shared flow network, supported by a quality-controlled corpus of 168,561 RNA structures, achieving improved designability and co-designability over existing baselines.
